decisions.rule: Generate as an independent noncreature battlefield element. Crossing is a separate main-step payment with matching colors. Recrossing targets a different creature; only an explicit ability permits free crossing.

Equipment follows evolution and reconstruction, including SSS invasion reconstruction. Revolution change detaches equipment. EX-life or Escape replacement keeps equipment attached. Incarnation checks prevent a returning card from regaining stale equipment.

Takion applies only to own Samurai summons and gear generation/crossing, with a minimum cost of one. Diamond Star ignores the whole reduction ability including crossing (QA43866). Unattached Zangeki reductions are optional; attached Zangeki checks holder Dragon/Samurai and grants power plus speed to own Dragon/Samurai creatures.

Keep the unselected looked-at cards protected through the chosen card execution, then let the controller order the rest on the bottom. Maroku may freely cross only the gear actually put onto the battlefield by that Mekraid.

Samurai Generate and own-shield-break entry abilities are independently ordered. The self shield S trigger fully resolves before the conditional 6000 destruction. A shield break replacement which prevents the break prevents the destruction.
Count fire and light elements including independent gears. Draw optionally per light element. Resolve attack use against the current hand size and the selected non-evolution Samurai/Armored face.

Shiro accepts cost-three-or-higher Armored or Mecha revolution bases; its cost-five spell lock persists until the next controller turn start. Its end-step untap is mandatory, subject to untap prohibitions. Flash completes Yobinion before untapping and snapshot granting Blocker; the grant expires on the next controller turn start and follows the same creature through evolution.
